items.title: Exit polls show AI ranked last among voter priorities in the 2026 U.S. midterms
items.summary: In the 2026 U.S. midterm elections, AI ranked last among campaign issues: only 56 percent of respondents cited AI and data centers as an important factor. According to NBC exit polls, corruption (90 percent) and the cost of living (89 percent) clearly dominated, despite growing public attention to the issue. items.title: Schools that turn off Google's AI will lose search too starting in 2027
items.summary: Starting in 2027, Google plans to turn off AI features in its school products by default, letting schools decide what to enable. The catch: schools that block AI entirely on their devices will also lose access to Google Search, since the two systems are now too deeply intertwined to separate. items.title: OpenAI says GPT-6 Astra designed a hardware device from scratch in under a week
items.summary: OpenAI's hardware team used GPT-6 Astra to design a device for the Codex coding agent in under a week, handling everything from the enclosure to the circuit board to the firmware. Several revision rounds were needed before production because the model didn't always account for manufacturing tolerances. items.title: Rapid LLM development is outrunning the research meant to explain it, study finds
items.summary: Stanford researchers tested 50 widely cited claims about LLMs against 20 current models. 44 percent of the findings are already "expired," and another 34 percent have weakened significantly. The average lifespan is just 15.7 months. Claims about what models can't do expire fastest. The article Rapid LLM development is outrunning the research meant to explain it, study finds appeared first on The Decoder.

items.title: AI agents take over at SETI's Allen Telescope Array, scanning for extraterrestrial intelligence
items.summary: The SETI Institute and Breakthrough Listen are now using AI agents at the Allen Telescope Array to control the telescope and analyze incoming radio signals. Tasks that used to take weeks can now wrap up in hours, and the team says the system detected a pulsar in the Crab Nebula in real time for the first time. items.title: Anthropic's Message Threads cut time to first token by 35 percent for long conversations
items.summary: Anthropic released Message Threads for the Messages API. Instead of resending the entire conversation with every turn, agents now only transmit what's changed. For requests between 500,000 and one million tokens, time to first token drops by about 35 percent. items.title: Huawei tells customers to find their own AI chip memory, effectively outsourcing procurement to the black market
items.summary: Huawei is telling customers to source the high-performance memory for its AI chips on their own, pushing them onto the black market. Smugglers are exploiting a loophole in U.S. export rules by bundling HBM with low-end processors, shipping them through Hong Kong, and separating the chips on site.
